scenes.event: Group of friends meeting for coffee after Spencer's graduation
scenes.location: A cozy corner of a local café
scenes.description: Spencer, Yury, and Hong are seated at a small table. A few other friends from Spencer's university are present, but the conversation is mostly between Spencer, Yury, and Hong. Spencer sits quietly, observing the interactions around him, while Yury and Hong engage in animated discussion.

characters.name: Spencer White
characters.description: Spencer is a recent graduate, visibly introverted and self-conscious. He sits with a notebook on his lap, pretending to read it as a way to avoid direct eye contact and conversation.; Male, Early, 25 years old; Occupation: Recent Graduate; Personality: Introverted, Sensitive, Self-conscious, Empathetic; Values: Self-esteem, Emotional Authenticity, Independence; Interests: Social Observation, Music, Self-reflection; Experiences: Unresolved social conflicts, Awkward interactions, Emotional suppression, Peer pressure, Self-doubt
characters.position: Seated at the table, slightly apart from the others

characters.name: Yury Kim
characters.description: Yury is a confident and playful friend of Spencer's, known for their teasing but well-meaning nature; Non-binary; Age: 24; Occupation: Digital Marketing Specialist; Personality: witty, empathetic, outgoing; Values: authenticity, loyalty, growth; Interests: social media trends, indie music, baking; Experiences: worked on several successful student-led startups, studied abroad in Seoul during university, helped Spencer through a tough breakup with humor and support.

characters.name: Hong Li
characters.description: Hong is a warm and enthusiastic friend who genuinely wants Spencer to feel included; Female; Age: 24; Occupation: Event Coordinator; Personality: Sociable, optimistic, perceptive; Values: Community, loyalty, kindness; Interests: Planning social gatherings, trying new local cuisines, photography; Experiences: Organized several university friend reunions, helped Spencer integrate into a new study group, recently launched a community volunteer initiative.

actions.action: Leans in and speaks with a playful tone
actions.dialogue: Come on, Spence, you can't just sit there with your notebook like it's a shield. We all know you're just trying to avoid talking about your thesis again.
Yury, don't be too hard on them. Spencer worked really hard on that thesis. I think it's amazing how much he put into it.

actions.action: Looks down and hesitates before responding
actions.dialogue: I just... I don't want to talk about it. It was a lot of work, but I don't think it means anything to anyone else.

actions.action: Sighs and shifts tone to be more sincere
actions.dialogue: You know, Spence, it means something to us. We care. But you have to let us in sometimes.
We're all proud of you, Spencer. Maybe you could tell us a bit about the music you listened to while working on it. You always had such a unique taste.

actions.action: Relaxes slightly and begins to open up
actions.dialogue: Oh... Yeah, I did. Mostly jazz and classical. It helped me focus. I used to listen to Miles Davis when I felt overwhelmed.

scenes.plot: Spencer is invited to a coffee catch-up by Yury and Hong after graduation. While initially withdrawn and anxious, the conversation slowly draws him out as the group shifts to a more personal and supportive tone.
scenes.social_purpose: To demonstrate Spencer's struggle with social anxiety and his desire for emotional authenticity and acceptance, while showing how others can help him feel included.

chunk.text: Spencer sits at the table, notebook in hand, as Yury and Hong try to include him in the conversation. Their teasing and support gradually help him open up, revealing his interests and values in a natural way.
